title: Made in Italy needs a memory system
governingQuestion: What survives Milan after the room, stream and order book close?
status: evidence-backed draft; recording, named interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: Made in Italy needs a memory system
longform.opening: Made in Italy cannot continue without systems that remember how it was made.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: Italy’s public archive and museum surfaces, Modateca Deanna and Politecnico di Milano preserve different slices of fashion knowledge: records, objects, textiles and research.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: CNMI’s live gallery and video surfaces preserve selected official images and moving-image records, but discovery does not equal permission to reproduce.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: No complete public, rights-cleared archive of every Milan show, worker, venue, invitation, technical credit and commercial outcome was located.

longform.closing: Milan’s technology is not futurist decoration. It is the system that moves authority from name to room to object to record.

spokenScript: Made in Italy cannot continue without systems that remember how it was made.
Italy’s public archive and museum surfaces, Modateca Deanna and Politecnico di Milano preserve different slices of fashion knowledge: records, objects, textiles and research.
CNMI’s live gallery and video surfaces preserve selected official images and moving-image records, but discovery does not equal permission to reproduce.
The system: Archives, film, image rights, preservation.
The limit: No complete public, rights-cleared archive of every Milan show, worker, venue, invitation, technical credit and commercial outcome was located.
